title: Terms of Use
intro: These Terms govern the use of the LOC RÉACTION S.A.S platform by clients and partner drivers.
s1_text: The platform connects clients with professional VTC drivers, and allows quote requests for real estate rental, construction, gardening and project management assistance services.
s2_text: The ride-hailing rate is €1.70/km, displayed before any booking confirmation. The client agrees to honour every confirmed ride.
s3_text: The client may cancel a ride as long as it has not reached "in progress" status. Repeated unjustified cancellations may result in account suspension.
s4_text: Payment is made through the platform's built-in electronic wallet, automatically debited at the end of each ride.
s5_text: The partner driver must hold a valid VTC professional licence, valid professional insurance, and comply with traffic regulations.
s6_text: LOC RÉACTION S.A.S acts as a technical intermediary. Responsibility for the performance of the ride lies with the partner driver.
s7_text: These Terms are governed by French law. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the courts of the registered office.
